column1: Aggregate supply (AS) is the relationship between the quantity of goods and services supplied and the price level. Because the firms that supply goods and services have flexible prices in the long run but sticky prices in the short run, the aggregate supply relationship depends on the time horizon. We need to discuss two different aggregate supply curves: the long-run aggregate supply curve LRAS and the short-run aggregate supply curve SRAS. We also need to discuss how the economy makes the transition from the short run to the long run.
